verdict.rationale: Graphite ships a well-documented official CLI (`gt`) installable via npm/Homebrew, fully git-compatible, with configuration (`gt config`) and a full command reference, and this is corroborated by extensive hands-on community use praising the CLI workflow. It also integrates with AI agent workflows via GT MCP for stacked PR creation, reinforcing agentic use. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of CLI performance/reliability beyond anecdotal community reports (e.g., some bug reports on rebase/signing edge cases).
